description: Pick up a disposable cup and place it into a drop zone.

context_action.label: observe_qr_for_coordinate_localization
context_action.instruction: Observe the QR marker and preserve these context frames for coordinate localization.

left_hand.label: left_hand_during_qr_localization
left_hand.instruction: Keep the left hand observable while the QR coordinate frame is established.

right_hand.label: right_hand_during_qr_localization
right_hand.instruction: Keep the right hand observable while the QR coordinate frame is established.

atomic_actions.label: approach_and_acquire_cup
atomic_actions.instruction: Approach and acquire the disposable cup with the grippers.

left_hand.label: left_hand_during_cup_approach_and_acquisition
left_hand.instruction: Use the left hand to approach, acquire, or stabilize the cup as observed.

right_hand.label: right_hand_during_cup_approach_and_acquisition
right_hand.instruction: Use the right hand to approach, acquire, or stabilize the cup as observed.

atomic_actions.label: transport_cup_to_box
atomic_actions.instruction: Transport the acquired disposable cup to the box.

left_hand.label: left_hand_during_cup_transport
left_hand.instruction: Use the left hand to carry or support the cup during transport as observed.

right_hand.label: right_hand_during_cup_transport
right_hand.instruction: Use the right hand to carry or support the cup during transport as observed.

atomic_actions.label: place_and_release_cup_in_drop_zone
atomic_actions.instruction: Place and release the disposable cup in the box drop zone.

left_hand.label: left_hand_during_cup_placement_and_release
left_hand.instruction: Use the left hand to place, release, or stabilize the cup as observed.

right_hand.label: right_hand_during_cup_placement_and_release
right_hand.instruction: Use the right hand to place, release, or stabilize the cup as observed.

atomic_actions.label: retreat_from_drop_zone
atomic_actions.instruction: Retreat the grippers from the box drop zone.

left_hand.label: left_hand_retreat_from_drop_zone
left_hand.instruction: Retreat the left hand from the drop zone.

right_hand.label: right_hand_retreat_from_drop_zone
right_hand.instruction: Retreat the right hand from the drop zone.
